CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

3. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)

   D. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
